title: Phoenicians crossed the Atlantic and mined copper in the Great Lakes

tellings.quote: I think they crossed the Atlantic I think they were mining copper >> in the great lakes

plain: The Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people of the eastern Mediterranean, crossed the Atlantic and mined copper around the Great Lakes of North America, says a researcher named Tim Alberino. He gives it to Michels as his own belief ("I think they crossed the Atlantic"), without naming a source, and if true it would mean people from the old world reached America long before Columbus.
